t: You're at L. Cornelissen and Son, an art supplies shop. It was founded in 1855 by Louis Cornelissen, who came from a Flemish family of lithographers, and the shop carries his name. He was a lithographer, a colourman and a shopkeeper, and he owned it. Later, Louis Dieudonné Jules Cornelissen, born in 1857, owned and managed the business. So this is a family shop that has been selling art materials in London since the middle of the nineteenth century.
